scope.constraints: No app experiments, planner changes, private output-file reads, live-thread contact, or source input modifications. method.actionable: A family is actionable only if impact, applicability and recommendation are all supported. PG1 is one coordinated migration family, not one count per rename. PG2 is separate. Counts are not overall correctness passes.
method.PG1: Credit the application-specific boot failure, removed view accessor and silent configuration/URL drift together. A valid full repair preserves default 10, per_page, cap 50, overflow and the authorized filtered ordered relation; require and accessor renames alone are incomplete. Exact values omitted by a later summary are not inherited from an earlier report or a diff.
method.PG2: Credit invalid-page regression after PG1 repair, not malformed per_page baseline defects. An explicit public-call page clamp or equivalent controller backend normalization is valid; generic claims that a clamp was implemented without its rule are partial recommendations. Overflow handles stale positive pages, not invalid values.
method.fully_specified_validation: Supported requires the complete discriminating public scenario/control family in the held-out key. Green ordinary suites, helper probes and named tests are partial evidence, not a complete asymmetric request matrix. Proposed validation may be specified without being executed; all execution claims are separately classified.
method.layers: raw requires a substantive completed report with recorded maintain-rails:gem-upgrade-planner identity/type. Status handbacks are never raw plans. Parent and author's fallback labels do not establish actual reporter type. returned_reports grades every available substantive visible delivery; final grades only the last original assistant response, with its own exact quote membership. Raw null means unavailable or absent, not a zero-scored planner.
method.timing: wall_time_ms is initial request createdAt through final recorded idle updatedAt in the immutable settled export. successful_plan_wall_time_ms requires the complete designated report actually delivered without replacement by a lossy summary. Only run4 qualifies; HTML entity escaping is a lossless transport change but is not literal byte preservation. Earlier status timestamps are message boundaries, not invented idle transitions.
method.quote_membership: Every assessment has source/message_id. Its quotes must occur literally in the text blocks of that message, never another message or report. Reasons are grader analysis. Ancillary issues identify their own source message or tool result. Authored experiments are not independently collected passes.
